**💡 Today's learning: "A diamond ring is an age-old way to say forever"**
- **🤔 What people believe:** A diamond engagement ring is an old tradition, and love means a diamond.
- **🔬 The fact:** "A diamond is forever" was written for De Beers and became its official slogan in 1947. An Auburn University history PhD study (2019) used the ad agency N.W. Ayer & Son's own records to show how its ads, from the Great Depression to the 1990s, made the diamond ring the symbol of love in America.
- **🎯 How they fool you:** Make a product feel like a ritual and people stop comparing prices: nobody haggles over "forever". Watch for it in festive jewellery ads this Diwali.
- Source: https://etd.auburn.edu/handle/10415/6678
